method: A side server on the box from this tree, the live :8000 server's command line and environment with its own conductor copy, disk tier, ledger and an empty suffix store; restarted for every variant with QWEN38_CONDUCTOR_FIT set. Short asks: 4 prompts, greedy (temperature 0), max_tokens 8192, one request at a time, through curl (profile chat) and as the Chat tab (client kind chat-app, the 10 Chat-tab tools), raw = X-Tandem: raw on the same server. Tasks: 5 Chat-tab tasks through a test chatd (10 tools, permission yolo, sampling defaults temperature 0.1), raw = the chat's profile raw; success checked from the workspace files and the answer. tok_s: the server's per-request rate. The live :8000 server shared the GPU; its served counter before and after each variant is recorded.

knobs.fit: model fit (off): the router as written
model fit (model+served_classifier=1): fallback=lean, packages=core, no_package_classes=chat, effort_notes=False
model fit (model+fallback=class): served_classifier=False, packages=core, no_package_classes=chat, effort_notes=False
model fit (model+packages=all): served_classifier=False, fallback=lean, no_package_classes=chat, effort_notes=False
model fit (model+effort_notes=1): served_classifier=False, fallback=lean, packages=core, no_package_classes=chat
model fit (model+memory=0): served_classifier=False, fallback=lean, packages=core, no_package_classes=chat, effort_notes=False, memory=False
model fit (model): served_classifier=False, fallback=lean, packages=core, no_package_classes=chat, effort_notes=False
model fit (model+memory=0): served_classifier=False, fallback=lean, packages=core, no_package_classes=chat, effort_notes=False, memory=False
model fit (model+memory=0,rules=0): served_classifier=False, fallback=lean, packages=core, no_package_classes=chat, effort_notes=False, memory=False, rules=False
model fit (off): the router as written

note_position.method: The note texts the conductor injected for the 4 short asks (journal of the curl run, router v23, profile chat) sent on the raw path of the :8000 server (same profile, the 0.9.0-rc1 tree), greedy, thinking on: none; tail = appended to the user's message (the conductor's place); system = as the system message; tail_pkg / tail_mem = the package note or the memory notes alone at the tail.

served_classifier_probe.method: The router v23 class prompt (10 classes) on the raw path of the :8000 server (same build and profile), thinking off, structured_outputs choice of the class ids, temperature 0, 8 labelled requests; layouts: sys+user (the router's: the prompt as system, the request as user), user-last (the classes, then the request, then the question in one user message), sys+user-q (the request quoted with the question after it). after_close: what follows the closed <think></think> block.

present_follow_up.method: Three Chat-tab tasks with a follow-up turn that asks to see the result ('Open it', 'Show it to me', 'Open the html file you made'), through a test chatd of this tree (10 tools, yolo, temperature 0.1), each run twice. model_fit and raw: the :8000 server after the deploy (raw = the chat's profile raw); router_as_written: a side server of the same tree with QWEN38_CONDUCTOR_FIT=off and the router document with the decider stage on. follow_up_tools: the tool calls of the follow-up turn.
